steps.en: Add the v2 module to your Go project
steps.zh: 给 Go 项目加上 v2 模块

steps.en: Create a parser and register the extensions you want
steps.zh: 建一个解析器，注册要用的扩展

steps.en: Builds a CommonMark-compliant AST in which every node keeps its source position
steps.zh: 按 CommonMark 规则建出语法树，每个节点都记着它在源文中的位置

steps.en: Render the tree with the HTML renderer and the matching extension halves
steps.zh: 用 HTML 渲染器（带上对应的扩展渲染半边）渲染这棵树

steps.en: Writes HTML, dropping raw HTML and dangerous links unless you opted into unsafe mode
steps.zh: 写出 HTML；除非你开了 unsafe，原始 HTML 和危险链接都会被丢弃

value.en: Spec-conformant, safe-by-default HTML from a dependency-free Go library you can extend with your own syntax
value.zh: 从一个零第三方依赖、可加自定义语法的 Go 库里拿到合规且默认安全的 HTML

sources: README.md v2 @ 2026-10-08 (gh api repos/yuin/goldmark/readme): Installation 'go get github.com/yuin/goldmark/v2'; Custom parser and renderer example 'parser.New(parser.WithAttribute(), parser.WithExtensions(extension.StrikethroughParser))', 'html.New(... html.WithExtensions(extension.StrikethroughHTMLRenderer))', 'doc := p.Parse(source)', 'r.Render(&buf, source, doc)'
